body:
Dear Friend,
We need your products urgently. Payment will be made by USDT or Bitcoin only.
Please send invoice immediately and use a private account for faster settlement.
Waiting for your urgent reply.
reply:
Dear Friend,

Thank you for your urgent inquiry regarding our products. However, before we can proceed, could you please provide details about the specific products you are interested in, as well as your location? This information will help us move forward effectively.
Best Regards.
Xian Diao
DIOX Ltd.
